method: Loaded and checked six retained diagnostic streams/reports. Compared exact (track_id,direction,crossing_frame_start,crossing_frame_end) keys and confirmation frame deltas; inspected stored source-measurement links for named cases. No model, tracker, encoder, state-machine, or source-video rerun. This review performs no direct pixel inspection; prior pixel review is a referenced separate artifact.

review_findings.finding: At zero band, requiring two destination observations removes seven of 160 exact crossing keys; all 153 retained keys confirm one frame later. At maximum band, five of 133 keys are removed and 128 retained keys confirm one frame later. These are diagnostic changes, not correctness labels.

At median band, c1 confirms B_TO_A from5019→5020 at5020. c2 does not confirm that earlier passage; it confirms B_TO_A from5021→5022 at5024. Thus c2 removes four c1 keys and introduces one different key, for totals153→150; transition membership is not simply monotonic under added confirmation.

Zero-band variants produce B_TO_A diagnostics for person967, class-handoff964, and motorcycle973 across5125→5126,5128→5129,5129→5130 respectively. Median band retains967 and964, with confirmation delayed, while973 establishes first eligible origin atA5130 rather thanB5129 and has no transition. Maximum band retains967 and suppresses both964 and973. Suppression is parameter-dependent, not an implemented physical-identity deduplication policy.

All six variants retain both B_TO_A diagnostic keys:1774 at7717→7718 and1772 at7721→7722. Confirmations range7718→7722 for1774 and7722→7727 for1772. The stored raw classes are person for1774 and person→motorcycle from origin to confirmation for1772; labels are not accepted product categories.

All six variants mark6017→6019 for1217 and7559→7565 for1712 AMBIGUOUS_GAP, with one/five missing observed frames and interpolation_used=False. Neither software ID has any GEOMETRY_TRANSITION in these six streams. The1217 raw-class car→truck change remains visible as measurement provenance, not resolved classification.

Control emits two opposite diagnostics for893 at4978/4979 and three for912 at5020/5021/5022. Every other variant emits none for893;912 retains one B_TO_A, with cross-pair and confirmation dependent on configuration. Raw measurements alone do not establish jitter, physical return, or category correctness.

Compared with zero band at the same confirmation setting, matched median-band confirmations are delayed0–2 frames; matched maximum-band confirmations are delayed1–9 frames. The larger band excludes candidate origins/destinations as well as transient excursions. Delays are decoder-frame indices, not authoritative source timing.

parameter_decision.reason: Three measured one-frame sign excursions are insufficient to establish a general jitter distribution; named duplicates/component handoff remain. Quantitative output frequencies have no ground-truth correctness labels, and this agent does not directly inspect source pixels. Retain zero-band/c1 as labelled diagnostic control, not selected deployment default.

limitations: No ground truth; no accuracy, precision, recall, F1, MAPE, physical counting result, or ReID benefit established.
All raw classes remain diagnostic inputs; software IDs are not unique physical vehicles.
Comparison keys identify retained measured geometric passages, not actual unique traffic events.
No direct source-pixel review was performed by this output-analysis agent. Prior bounded visual review findings retain their original scope; root may add separately verified source pixels.
Absent transitions have not been reclassified as false positives or false negatives.
No suitable numeric default or Phase6 implementation is selected.
